body.label: Target
body.html: An area or group within weapon range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose a 1-unit burst within weapon range. Compare this Action against each creature in the burst. On a success, deal 1 weapon damage.

surges.html: Choose one additional eligible target at the edge of the area.

rider.title: SALVO
rider.html: If your Locked target is in the area, you may exclude one ally from this Action's targets.
